title: NanmiCoder/cc-haha
claim: NanmiCoder/cc-haha — Local-first cross-platform desktop workspace for Claude Code / agents: multi-agent, Git worktrees, code diffs, skill mar
why_good: Claude Code Haha is a cross-platform desktop app that wraps Claude Code and other AI agents into a visual workspace. It provides multi-session workspaces, global search, branch/worktree launch, diff review, built-in browser preview, GUI permission approval, and supports any model (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, local endpoints).
value: Individual developers and small teams who use Claude Code or other AI agents and want a more visual, safer, and more productive workflow will pay for a polished desktop app that saves time and reduces errors.
risk: The main risk is that Anthropic or another platform adds these features natively, making the app obsolete. Also, the app may be seen as a feature, not a standalone product.

does: Claude Code Haha is a cross-platform desktop app that wraps Claude Code and other AI agents into a visual workspace. It provides multi-session workspaces, global search, branch/worktree launch, diff review, built-in browser preview, GUI permission approval, and supports any model (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, local endpoints).
why_use: Terminal-based Claude Code is powerful but opaque: you can't see what the agent is doing, you can't easily review diffs, and you have to trust it with permissions. Haha gives you a visual interface to see tool calls, review changes, and approve actions with a GUI, making agent use safer and more transparent.
gap: It's a developer tool with no consumer-facing product around it, leaving the non-technical user case empty.
counter: Anthropic could add a GUI to Claude Code itself, or a platform like GitHub Copilot could integrate similar features. Also, many developers are comfortable with the terminal and may not see the need for a separate app.
differentiator: I would focus on making the app more accessible to non-technical users and localize it for the Chinese market, with a simplified setup and Chinese language support.
hook: Developers using Claude Code in the terminal are frustrated by the lack of visibility into what the agent is doing, the difficulty of managing multiple sessions, and the risk of approving dangerous actions blindly.

zh.claim: 一个本地优先的桌面工作区，用于 Claude Code 和其他 AI 代理，具有多会话工作区、Git worktree、差异审查、内置浏览器预览、GUI 权限批准，并支持任何模型。
zh.hook: 在终端中使用 Claude Code 的开发人员感到沮丧，因为无法看到代理在做什么，难以管理多个会话，并且盲目批准危险操作存在风险。
zh.does: Claude Code Haha 是一个跨平台桌面应用，将 Claude Code 和其他 AI 代理包装成可视化工作区。它提供多会话工作区、全局搜索、分支/worktree 启动、差异审查、内置浏览器预览、GUI 权限批准，并支持任何模型（Claude、ChatGPT、Grok、本地端点）。
zh.why_use: 基于终端的 Claude Code 功能强大但不透明：你看不到代理在做什么，难以审查差异，并且必须信任它的权限。Haha 为你提供可视化界面，查看工具调用、审查更改，并通过 GUI 批准操作，使代理使用更安全、更透明。
zh.gap: 当前产品是一个桌面应用，需要安装和配置，这可能对某些用户构成障碍。此外，中国市场的情况尚未完全解决，因为 README 主要是英文，UI 可能未完全本地化。
zh.counter: Anthropic 可能会在 Claude Code 本身添加 GUI，或者 GitHub Copilot 等平台可能会集成类似功能。此外，许多开发人员对终端感到舒适，可能不认为需要单独的应用程序。
zh.differentiator: 我会专注于使应用对非技术用户更易用，并针对中国市场进行本地化，提供简化的设置和中文语言支持。
zh.value: 使用 Claude Code 或其他 AI 代理并希望获得更可视化、更安全、更高效工作流程的个人开发者和团队将付费购买一个精致的桌面应用，以节省时间并减少错误。
zh.risk: 主要风险是 Anthropic 或其他平台原生添加这些功能，使应用过时。此外，该应用可能被视为一个功能，而不是独立产品。
zh.why_good: Claude Code Haha 是一个跨平台桌面应用，将 Claude Code 和其他 AI 代理包装成可视化工作区。它提供多会话工作区、全局搜索、分支/worktree 启动、差异审查、内置浏览器预览、GUI 权限批准，并支持任何模型（Claude、ChatGPT、Grok、本地端点）。

consumer_angle: An ordinary person could use this to manage AI coding agents visually, but the current interface is still too technical for them.
pick_reason: Strong demand evidence but the gap is not yet a clear consumer opportunity.
